plain.text: Jesus took Peter, James and John up a high mountain, and he was transfigured: his face shone like the sun and his clothes became white as light. Moses and Elijah appeared, talking with him. Peter offered to build three shelters. A bright cloud covered them and a voice said, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased. Listen to him! The disciples fell down terrified, but Jesus touched them: Get up, don't be afraid. Coming down, he told them to tell no one until he had risen, and said Elijah had already come in John the Baptist.

A man knelt before Jesus and begged him to heal his son, who had seizures; the disciples had not been able to. Jesus rebuked the demon and the boy was healed. Later the disciples asked why they had failed. Because you have so little faith, Jesus said. Even faith as small as a mustard seed can move a mountain.

In Galilee Jesus told them again that he would be betrayed, killed and raised on the third day, and they were filled with grief. In Capernaum, collectors of the temple tax asked whether Jesus paid it. Jesus said the king's children are exempt, but so as not to offend, he told Peter to catch a fish, and in its mouth he would find a coin to pay for them both.

summary.bigIdea: On the mountain the disciples glimpse Jesus' glory, and God tells them to listen to his Son.
points: Jesus shines with glory, with Moses and Elijah beside him.
Even faith as small as a mustard seed is enough.
summary.reflection: God's command was simply, listen to him. How could you make more room to listen to Jesus?
